decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The resultant two-storey detached house, by reason of its bulk, height and excessive depth, would harm the living conditions of the neighbouring bungalow to the west, by reason of loss of light and outlook to the ground floor rear kitchen/dining room window, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - Informative: In the event that either of the approved planning permissions at 29 Kings Avenue (reference numbers 00662/29/P5 or 00662/29/P6) were to implemented, the Council would have had no objections to this proposal, as it would not under those circumstances result in harm to the living conditions of the residents at 29 Kings Avenue as extended.  Without either of these extensions the proposal is not considered acceptable.  If either of these permissions are carried out, you should consider resubmitting your application which will then be likely to receive favorable consideration.
description: ERECTION OF A FIRST FLOOR AND A FIRST FLOOR REAR EXTENSION INCORPORATING TWO REAR DORMERS TO A BUNGALOW TO CREATE TWO-STOREY DETACHED HOUSE
